properties.description: Built 2026-10-17 in reflow2-core's detect module and the MCP ask tools. `ask_question` records a Question with no `gap_id` (now optional), `asked_of` a Contributor (required, checked), ASKS_ABOUT each node in `about` (at least one, each checked), in an optional batch; everything is checked before anything is written; the wording never changes once asked. open_questions lists it like any waiting question, every row now carrying `origin` (`gap` / `asker`); loop_status counts it in unanswered_questions and loop_status(contributor_id) lists it in questions_put_to_them; answer_question with `answered_by` records who answered. In the primes trial the designer parked three such questions as edgeless Decisions.
properties.name: An agent puts its own question to a named person about the nodes it concerns, and it waits like any question (ask_question)
